text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — increased 502/504 rates from us-west-2c edge (ELB) since 12:12 UTC. PagerDuty: PD-49321. Auto-escalating to on-call.
amelia_oncall: I'm on it, investigating now. Paging darren for infra visibility.
ben_sre: seeing ELB 5xx spike at the same time as EC2 target unhealthy counts climbing for targets in us-west-2c. CloudWatch shows RX errors on eni-0a1b2c3d (us-west-2c).
maya_eng: Route53 health checks for the regional weighted record also show increased latency/timeout, might be DNS propagation making retries worse.
darren_ops: on my side I see packet drops on the AZ fabric at ~12:10-12:15 UTC per VPC flow logs, correlated with kernel rx_errors on a subset of hosts. Opening console to drain unhealthy hosts from target group.
amelia_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) drain targets in TG serving us-west-2c, 2) shift Route53 weights off us-west-2c to 2a/2b as temporary, 3) raise min capacity in those AZs. Executing now.
amelia_oncall: running weight change (will share CLI):
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2c","Weight":0,"TTL":60}},{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2a","Weight":50,"TTL":60}},{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2b","Weight":50,"TTL":60}}]}'
```
ben_sre: confirmed change pushed. Route53 change id: /change/C000EXAMPLE. TTL is 60s so should shift within couple mins but clients with cached entries might still hit 2c for a bit.
lucas_support: any initial customer impact numbers? Support getting a handful of reports: 5 customers, mostly higher throughput integrations, seeing 502s. We should surface affected customers list for comms.
ben_sre: quick estimate from metrics: region-wide error-rate bump ~3.4% of total requests. For the affected TG the error-rate peaked ~18% for ~6 minutes.
amelia_oncall: noted. Lucas can you prepare targeted comms for top 5 customers and include workaround (retry/backoff)? Evelyn, looping PM for customer impact.
evelyn_pm: thanks — we'll draft a short status with ETA for full recovery (TBD). Please include mitigation steps and whether session state could be impacted.
darren_ops: draining in-progress: deregistering 6 hosts from tg-prod-3, forcing connection close. Also bumping ASG desired capacity in 2a/2b by +20 to absorb load.
maya_eng: I'm watching backend logs — downstream services are healthy; it's network-to-hosting path in 2c. No signs of app bugs.
incident-bot: Update: incident severity elevated to Sev2 due to customer-facing errors and partial region degradation. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/incidents/PD-49321
ben_sre: after weight shift and drains error rate dropping: 502s down from 18% -> 2.1% within 5 mins of routing change. Latency normalizing.
lucas_support: posting interim note to impacted customers with suggested retry/backoff and that we have shifted traffic. Will link to status page.
amelia_oncall: starting 30m timer for handoff; will monitor for stabilization. If error rate <1% for 15m we'll transition to recovery and start root-cause investigation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
darren_ops: agree — observed packet drop alarms in 2c cleared after drain but we'll keep monitoring infra metrics and coordinate with AWS if flapping returns.
evelyn_pm: capture any customer-visible sessions that may have failed — product team to prioritize replay/compensation flows if needed.
incident-bot: Note added to incident timeline: "weights shifted from us-west-2c -> 2a/2b; drains initiated; ASG scale +20 in 2a/2b."
ben_sre: running post-mitigation checks — synthetic canaries show 200 OK from edge across regions. Error budget impact estimated ~0.15% of monthly budget so far.
amelia_oncall: handoff: I'm handing to darren_ops for overnight watch. Handoff notes: 1) watch for RX errors reappearing on ENIs in 2c, 2) coordinate with AWS NOC if we see recurrence, 3) don't re-enable weight for 2c until manual sign-off.
darren_ops: taking over. ping me if anything spikes. Will start a dedicated check loop and follow up in 30m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT status: monitoring -> mitigating -> stabilizing. Final update to be posted after RCA.
amelia_oncall: thanks team, good work. Closing PD incident once darren confirms stability. :white_check_mark:
